content.text: If you purchase a product or register for an account through one of the links on our site, we may receive compensation. Learn more > Team USA will send its top pitcher to the mound on Sunday night as it looks to shut down a loaded Dominican Republic squad in the World Baseball Classic semifinals.Pirates ace Paul Skenes will make his second start at the tournament after shutting down Mexico in group play. Skenes allowed just one hit across four innings and finished with seven strikeouts and one walk against Mexico. But the Dominican Republic's lineup will provide a much more difficult challenge for Skenes. Vladimir Guerrero Jr., Ketel Marte, Julio Rodriguez, Fernando Tatis Jr., Juan Soto — that's a lot of "Platano Power."Which team will earn a spot in the WBC championship game?Here is everything you need to know about USA vs. Dominican Republic, including TV and streaming options for the game.What channel is USA vs. Dominican Republic on tonight?TV channel: FS1Live stream: FuboUSA vs. Dominican Republic will air live on FS1.
